rows.jyutping: soeng2 zoeng6 ceot1 lei4 ge3 N
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that exists only in the imagination, such as an imaginary friend.

example.english: My imaginary friend really helped me a lot.
example.traditional: 想像出嚟嘅朋友真係幫咗我好多。
example.jyutping: soeng2 zoeng6 ceot1 lei4 ge3 pang4 jau5 zan1 hai6 bong1 zo2 ngo5 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this especially for a fictional character, story, or other invented thing rather than a personally imagined object.

example.english: The protagonist in this novel is an imaginary character.
example.traditional: 呢套小說入面嘅主角係虛構嘅人物。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 siu2 syut3 jap6 min6 ge3 zyu2 gok3 hai6 heoi1 kau3 ge3 jan4 mat6
